description: Bootstrap phase tracer and performance marks that record named startup phases to the Performance API, Sentry breadcrumbs, Datadog RUM timings, and the bootstrap-complete telemetry event. Lab performance benchmarks live outside src.

characterizationScenarios.name: Bootstrap phases record marks, RUM timings, and one completion event per page load

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
bootstrapTracer emits through the buffered datadogRum API before the telemetry registry exists, so it keeps importing the RUM SDK directly.
The bootstrapTracer singleton remains importable from bootstrap.ts, main.ts, and GraphView startup code.
